{{Top}}
[[File:GeonosianWarRoom-AotC.jpg|thumb|250px|This holomap was used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] to analyze the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]]]
'''Holomaps''' were topographic maps portrayed by [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] means, usually for military use. They displayed areas of the galaxy, and were used in exploration. Many holomaps have the ability to display images of ships and/or weaponry on certain planets or in certain regions, resulting in their use in strategic planning.

The [[Map to the Valley of the Jedi]] was created by stone tiles by [[Morgan Katarn]], and hidden from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Those were removed by the [[Seven Dark Jedi]] and [[administrative droid/Legends|administrative droid]] [[8t88/Legends|8t88]] reassembled them in the [[Government House (Sulon)|Government House]] on [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]]; he deciphered it and reconstructed the way to [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] as a 3d digital holomap which he transmitted to the [[Emperor's Hand]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] on board the ''[[Vengeance_(Vengeance-class)|Vengeance]]''. Even though the original tiles were destroyed, [[Kyle Katarn]] salvaged the holomap from 8t88's head.<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II">''[[Star_Wars:_Jedi_Knight:_Dark_Forces_II]]''</ref><ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>
